implemented: Native Pull uses captured fields/repository and original HEAD, Switch/Abort confirmation and separate owned checkout progress. Success auto-closes; failure retains selectable output until Close.
Tracking Yes/No/Cancel with AskSetTrackedBranch suppression, including suppression on Cancel; tracking writes affect the selected branch and execution resumes its guarded checkout checkpoint.
Incoming commits with graph, independent pinned incoming file comparison, Up to date and failed-Pull conflict/command-log results. Resolve routes to captured repository.
Pull split selection persists source entry indexes; four existing Fetch actions remain available.

Actual configured Pull rebase mode and pinned target route to an owned, repository-configured Rebase sheet. Incoming HEAD is read after dismissal; modeless activation cannot replace a sheet dismissal callback; forced parent close detaches busy Rebase to retained owner or closes idle child.
Owned checkout cancellation/close guards and one-shot progress dismissal prevent late publication and process/sheet leaks.

native.scope: Existing outgoing/Fetch/reference results plus real private local Pull fixtures: separate actual checkout controller, distinct pre-checkout incoming baseline, native graph/files table, tracking Yes/No/Cancel suppression, branch Abort, actual preserve-merges target/mode handoff callback, real merge conflict, failed-checkout output and Close action, controlled running-checkout force-close, late duplicate cancellation replies and unchanged refs.
native.rebase_limit: The handoff callback is injected and completes with private CLI fast-forward merge. Actual production Rebase sheet factory compiles but full runtime child/replay/physical acceptance is not established.
native.confirmation_limit: Checkout/tracking/cancellation answers are injected; actual alerts, physical buttons and accessibility acceptance are not certified.
